skill.name: google-maps-search-api-skill
skill.description: Extract structured business listings from Google Maps through a BrowserAct workflow, using keywords, language, country, and result count parameters.
skill.summary: Run BrowserAct Google Maps searches and return structured local business data.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs intended network calls to BrowserAct and reads a BrowserAct API key from the environment. Most Markdown backtick detections are false positives, but the skill does instruct command execution and unsafe API key solicitation. No evidence of prompt injection was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide the API key in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set locally before execution.
Document that the BrowserAct API receives the bearer token and search parameters. Redact secrets from logs and error messages.
Add clear usage limits, consent requirements, and compliance guidance for Google Maps terms, privacy rules, and anti-spam laws.

remediation.issue: Local script execution from skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Keep the command fixed, validate user parameters, and warn users before running the Python script with network access.

content.value_statement: Local business research can take hours when results are scattered across Google Maps. This skill submits focused searches to BrowserAct and returns structured place data.
actual_capabilities: Submits a BrowserAct Google Maps workflow task with search keywords.
Accepts language, country, and maximum result count parameters.
Polls BrowserAct task status and prints timestamped progress logs.
Reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the local environment for authentication.
Defines output fields such as business name, address, rating, reviews, and service options.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct account and BROWSERACT_API_KEY before use.
Sends search parameters and authorization headers to the BrowserAct API.
The current polling flow may stop before fetching completed task output.
Does not enforce legal, privacy, or Google Maps terms compliance.

use_cases.title: Build local sales lists
use_cases.description: Find businesses in a city and collect structured fields for outreach review.

use_cases.title: Compare market coverage
use_cases.description: Collect local competitors by category, country, and language for market mapping.

use_cases.title: Audit local search results
use_cases.description: Review ratings, review counts, and address data for service categories.

prompt_templates.title: Find nearby businesses
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to find coffee shops in Seattle. Use English, United States, and return 25 results.

prompt_templates.title: Research competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for boutique fitness studios in Austin. Return names, addresses, ratings, review counts, and service options.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare market notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Find coworking spaces in Berlin. Limit results to 40 and summarize pricing signals, ratings, and common amenities.

prompt_templates.title: Create prospecting input
prompt_templates.prompt: Run searches for dental clinics in Austin, Round Rock, and Cedar Park. Limit each query to 50 results and flag duplicates.

output_examples.output: A structured list of coworking spaces with names, addresses, ratings, review counts, amenity tags, and short review snippets.
A market research summary showing hotel names, locations, rating signals, price ranges, and review volume for comparison.

output_examples.input: Find dentists in Sydney for CRM review.
output_examples.output: A lead review table with clinic names, full addresses, ratings, review counts, and notes about missing fields.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment before running the skill.
Use specific keywords, country codes, and result limits to reduce noisy data.
Verify legal, privacy, and platform rules before using results for outreach.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys or other secrets into chat messages.
Do not use broad harvesting prompts without a legitimate business purpose.
Do not use collected business data for spam, harassment, or deceptive outreach.

faq.question: What account is required?
faq.answer: You need a BrowserAct account and a BROWSERACT_API_KEY set in the local environment.

faq.question: Does it browse Google Maps directly?
faq.answer: The script calls the BrowserAct workflow API, which performs the Google Maps search automation.

faq.question: What inputs can I control?
faq.answer: You can set search keywords, language, country, and the maximum number of results.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return business names, addresses, ratings, review counts, price signals, categories, tags, and review snippets.

faq.question: Can I paste my API key into the chat?
faq.answer: No. Set the key as BROWSERACT_API_KEY in your local environment before running the skill.

faq.question: What should I verify before outreach?
faq.answer: Check Google Maps terms, privacy rules, and anti-spam laws before using collected data for prospecting.
